# `Q-10-2` — Undefined Variable

> A template references a variable that is not defined in the
> current scope.

## What this means

Pandoc-flavored templates render variables with `$name$` or
`$nested.path$`. This error fires when the named variable does
not exist in the current scope — Quarto cannot fill the slot.
The template's behavior depends on its strict-mode setting: a
warning by default, an error when strict mode is on. In either
case the missing variable expands to the empty string.

## Why this happens

Common causes:

- **A typo in the variable name** (`$titel$` instead of
  `$title$`).
- **A variable that is set on some documents but not on
  others.** A shared template that references `$author$` will
  warn for any document whose front matter omits it.
- **A nested path that misses a field**: `$book.title$` when
  `book` is set but `book.title` is not.

## How to fix

Either add the variable (in the document's front matter, in
`_quarto.yml`, or in an included `_variables.yml`), or change
the template to use `$if(name)$ ... $endif$` to render the
slot only when the variable is present.
